commands.name: search-locations
commands.summary: Find places by name or postal code and get their coordinates, timezone, country and population. Use this first to turn a city name into latitude/longitude.

commands.name: get-forecast
commands.summary: Weather forecast for one or more coordinates: current conditions plus hourly and daily variables, up to 16 days ahead and 92 past days, with an optional national model (e.g. DWD ICON).

commands.name: export-forecast-csv
commands.summary: Download a weather forecast as CSV text (the docs page's CSV export), for spreadsheets or bulk processing.

commands.name: get-historical-weather
commands.summary: Historical observed-like weather (ERA5 reanalysis, 1940 to a few days ago) for coordinates over a date range, as hourly and/or daily variables.

commands.name: export-historical-csv
commands.summary: Download historical (ERA5) weather for a date range as CSV text.

commands.name: get-historical-forecast
commands.summary: Archived high-resolution model forecasts (from 2022 onward) for coordinates and a date range, with the same variables and models as the forecast API.

commands.name: get-previous-runs
commands.summary: Compare forecasts from earlier model runs at fixed lead times by requesting <variable>_previous_dayN variables alongside the current run.

commands.name: get-single-run
commands.summary: Full forecast horizon of one specific model run, identified by its initialisation time.

commands.name: get-ensemble-forecast
commands.summary: Ensemble forecast with every perturbed member (variable_memberNN), or ensemble mean/spread when you pass a *_ensemble_mean_* model.

commands.name: get-seasonal-forecast
commands.summary: Long-range seasonal and sub-seasonal forecast (ECMWF SEAS5 / EC46, about 6-7 months) with ensemble members.

commands.name: get-climate-projection
commands.summary: Downscaled daily climate-change projections from CMIP6 models for 1950-2050 at a location.

commands.name: get-marine-forecast
commands.summary: Marine forecast for a sea location: wave height, direction and period, swell, and ocean currents.

commands.name: get-air-quality
commands.summary: Air quality forecast: pollutants (PM10, PM2.5, ozone, NO2, ...), pollen, and European/US AQI, both hourly and current.

commands.name: get-satellite-radiation
commands.summary: Satellite-derived solar irradiance (GHI, direct, diffuse, DNI) for a location, near-real-time and archive.

commands.name: get-flood-forecast
commands.summary: Simulated river discharge (GloFAS) near a location, for flood forecasting: 1984 up to about 7 months ahead.

commands.name: get-elevation
commands.summary: Terrain elevation in meters (Copernicus DEM, 90 m) for one or more coordinates.
